tei:div.tei:p: In the early morning hour I call upon thee, my God, who art extolled; let my devout prayer be agreeable unto thee, on the day when my heart raiseth itself to thee; enlighten my darknessLet me understand thy holy Law. with the light of the morning, O my King and my God, for unto thee, I pray.

My foes who abhor thee, in their wrath reproach thy people; yet notwithstanding the tumult of those who rise up against thee, I bear in mind the fear of thee. O pour out upon them thine indignation, and anger, from thy heavenly dwelling, and be zealous, O Lord, for thy name, which is being profaned on earth. (O my King and my God, &c.)O my King and my God, for unto thee, I pray.

O living God, who ridest upon a swift cloud, if thou puttest me in the scale, let my righteousness be as weighty as the sand of the sea, and my wickedness as light as a feather; and if my path hath been crooked, and I deserve to be stoned to death, O weigh me in the scale of grace, for I am a man pierced by the sense of my transgressions. (O my King and my God, &c.)O my King and my God, for unto thee, I pray.

Restore the holy ark and its staves, and clothe Aaron again in his garments, and let the archer and hunteri.e., our persecutors. be duly requited, and each of them for his rebellion be consumed by the flames, so that they may be removed together as dung is taken away. (O my King and my God, &c.)O my King and my God, for unto thee, I pray.

O thou Most Holy, who sittest
in judgment upon all thy creatures, behold how my contentious adversaryi.e., our evil inclination. speaketh so haughtily of me, directeth his lance against me,i.e., trick to seduce me. and fighteth me with his sword;Combatteth with my better inclination. O save my soul, thou who frustrast evil counsel. (In the early morning, &c.)In the early morning hour I call upon thee, my God, who art extolled; let my devout prayer be agreeable unto thee, on the day when my heart raiseth itself to thee; enlighten my darkness with the light of the morning, O my King and my God, for unto thee, I pray.
